! Original OpenSwing harmonic verification example. SI input units.
! Fixed root, axial stiffness k=500 N/m, tip mass m=2 kg, damping time .02 s.
! Engine setting is a force in N along +y. Set gravity to zero, alpha=0.
! Tip y response per unit setting: 1 / [500*(1+i*.02*omega)-2*omega^2].
Name
Instrumented spring-mass demonstrator
End
Unit
L 1 m
T 1 s
F 1 N
End
Constant
9.80665 1.225 340.294
End
Reference
2 1 2
End
Ground
1 0 0
End
Weight
1 2 0 2 0 19.6133
End
Engine
1 0 1 2 0 2 0 0 1 0 1 0 -1 0 0
End
Beam 1
Axial spring
t y EA tdeps
0 0 1000 .02
2 2 1000 .02
End

! Default body-aligned pylon-tip pitot, accelerometer and GPS.
Sensor
1 1 0 0 0 .2
2 1 2 .3 2 .2
End

circulation_discretization.convention: Material arc coordinate s in [-L/2,L/2]; theta=acos(2*arc/L-1), decreasing pi to zero. Gamma=sum A_k sin(k theta). Weighted residual=(2/pi) sum R_i sin(k theta_i) delta_theta_i.
circulation_discretization.scope: Fourier modes are per logical lifting beam; refine mode count and structural intervals independently. Local flow defects need not vanish in a truncated series.

trefftz.convention: Frozen straight wake, infinite trailing filaments, theta-midpoint quadrature; D=-rho/2 sum(Gamma v_wake dot (wind cross delta_r)).
trefftz.scope: Lifting-surface circulation only; no body/profile/engine/apparent-mass drag or shed-wake history.

limitations: Quasi-steady snapshot with prescribed or force/moment-constrained motion; use time analysis to evolve a trajectory.
SO(3) midpoint beam discretization; refine the mesh to assess solution accuracy. ASWING discrete parity is unverified.
Rigid/pinned/roller/sprung joints, axial struts, body/point-volume flow and engine types 0/1/2 are supported.
Struts use an explicit bilateral or tension-only wire law; buckling loads are not specified by ASW input. See the numerical notes for formula ambiguities.
CDi and span efficiency use the frozen straight Trefftz wake; total CD and load balance use near-field forces, including CDi_near.

mesh_discretization.coordinates: Undeformed material arc length; theta decreases from pi to zero. Rigid position jumps contain no beam material.

limitations: Mechanical strain is recovered from current geometry; total section loads include material damping and do not alone determine strain.
Cshell/Nshell are offsets from the tension axis per steady eq. 28; the user guide labels them relative to the elastic axis. Executable parity is unverified.
The strain bound sums absolute axial and bending contributions. It bounds the specified rectangular extents, not an unspecified complete cross section.

Torsional shear stress assumes a thin, closed, uniform shell: torque about the elastic axis divided by twice Atshell. Transverse-shear stress, warping, normal stress and strength margins are not inferred.
Missing shell arms or nonpositive Atshell produce null material results. Negative Atshell is invalid; shell parameters do not change equilibrium.
These are element midpoint samples. Peaks at endpoints, joints and concentrated loads require local refinement; no interpolation across jumps is implied.
Sensor axes and locations follow their rigid pylons. Relative body position/velocity describe the beam anchor; GPS and inertial measurements describe the pylon tip.
Full airflow includes the implemented regularized lifting-line, volume, propulsive jet and gust fields. Near-filament/core and ASWING sensor-flow parity require independent refinement.

Structural force/moment use the inward endpoint trace and left trace at an interior anchor, in the anchor csn frame. Both adjacent traces are exported; exact ASWING trace choice at load/property jumps is unverified.
Mechanical strain and shell stress use the selected adjacent element material midpoint, whose location is reported. They are not exact nodal or pylon-tip strain measurements.
Zero airspeed makes flow angles undefined. At a vertical sensor V axis, bank/heading are undefined; Euler-angle branches are not a global attitude representation.
Selected measurements can drive scheduled feedback and differential error integrals. Full control-file index/unit mapping and arbitrary custom controller parity remain unverified.

equilibrium_state.units: Physical quantities in ASW input units; spatial rotation vectors in radians. Numerical solver scales are not stored.
limitations: This is a steady state. It contains no unsteady history or derivative state.
The source and mesh must match. Steady reuse corrects the full equilibrium; time launch validates the saved setup at zero local rates.
Local correction does not prove that a nonlinear branch is unique or that a fold has been followed.

integrator_deflation.criterion: Exact zero A row/column and exactly one nonzero M entry; no numerical zero threshold.

spectrum.left_recovery: Original A kernel for certified integrators; matched full-pencil generalized Schur vectors otherwise, with checked null-space fallback and repeated-pole pairing

derivative_linearization.method: physical load coefficient extraction and chain rule
derivative_linearization.hinge_derivative: analytic Jangle slope and SO(3) logarithm derivative
derivative_linearization.interpretation: Kinematic and controller-rate identities are exact. Fixed-state loads and measurements are at most quadratic in derivatives; symmetric physical probes extract their linear coefficient. No inertia threshold or matrix-entry snapping is applied.

node_coordinates.order: interleaved body translation / L and spatial rotation in radians

discretization.convention: Material arc coordinate s in [-L/2,L/2]; theta=acos(2*arc/L-1), decreasing pi to zero. Gamma=sum A_k sin(k theta). Weighted residual=(2/pi) sum R_i sin(k theta_i) delta_theta_i.
discretization.scope: Fourier modes are per logical lifting beam; refine mode count and structural intervals independently. Local flow defects need not vanish in a truncated series.

initial_conditions.interpretation: Complete finite descriptor subspace, including constitutive relaxation and integrator chains; no selected-mode truncation.

diagnostics.projection: Left mass-dual projection with complete real conjugate pairs; algebraic input lift uses the full finite subspace.

projection.interpretation: Mass-dual mode truncation of a constraint-consistent physical state. Error uses scaled dynamic coordinates, not physical energy.
Mass-dual mode truncation of a constraint-consistent physical state. Error uses scaled dynamic coordinates, not physical energy.

equations: zdot = A z + B du
dy = C z + D du + D_rate d(du)/dt
dx = state_lift z + state_input_lift du
For an initial profile: z(0) = state_projection dx(0); du = 0; z(t) = exp(A t) z(0)
limitations: This is a local frozen linear model. Truncated stable, unstable or lightly damped modes can change response and stability conclusions; compare the full system across the intended frequency range and refine the mode set and mesh.
Conjugate pairs are retained together. Dependent or defective selected modes are rejected; generalized eigenvector/Jordan models are not yet supported.

Constant real inputs support flap/engine settings, selected controller commands, active frame targets, prescribed accelerations and fixed spatial gusts. Convected gust phase requires frequency-dependent input matrices and is not supported by this constant-matrix export.

The algebraic lift retains direct constraint and acceleration response. Inputs requiring derivatives in the descriptor state are rejected. D_rate explicitly represents any derivative-input sensor feedthrough.
Named global and Sensor measurements use file physical units; all angular measurement outputs use degrees. State-lift rows use the documented scaled descriptor coordinates.

Initial profiles are completed in the full finite descriptor space before mass-dual projection. Omitted state and output errors are reported; this is a frozen linear free response, not nonlinear time initialization. Laplace convergence is checked against the full spectrum, including omitted unstable modes.
OpenSwing ROM JSON and text are versioned original formats. Legacy ASWING .rom byte compatibility and published aircraft/experimental ROM validation remain unverified.

integrator_deflation.criterion: Exact zero A row/column and exactly one nonzero M entry; no numerical zero threshold.

spectrum.left_recovery: Original A kernel for certified integrators; matched full-pencil generalized Schur vectors otherwise, with checked null-space fallback and repeated-pole pairing

derivative_linearization.method: physical load coefficient extraction and chain rule
derivative_linearization.hinge_derivative: analytic Jangle slope and SO(3) logarithm derivative
derivative_linearization.interpretation: Kinematic and controller-rate identities are exact. Fixed-state loads and measurements are at most quadratic in derivatives; symmetric physical probes extract their linear coefficient. No inertia threshold or matrix-entry snapping is applied.

node_coordinates.order: interleaved body translation / L and spatial rotation in radians

discretization.convention: Material arc coordinate s in [-L/2,L/2]; theta=acos(2*arc/L-1), decreasing pi to zero. Gamma=sum A_k sin(k theta). Weighted residual=(2/pi) sum R_i sin(k theta_i) delta_theta_i.
discretization.scope: Fourier modes are per logical lifting beam; refine mode count and structural intervals independently. Local flow defects need not vanish in a truncated series.

initial_conditions.interpretation: Complete finite descriptor subspace, including constitutive relaxation and integrator chains; no selected-mode truncation.

diagnostics.projection: Left mass-dual projection with complete real conjugate pairs; algebraic input lift uses the full finite subspace.

projection.interpretation: Mass-dual mode truncation of a constraint-consistent physical state. Error uses scaled dynamic coordinates, not physical energy.

equations: zdot = A z + B du
dy = C z + D du + D_rate d(du)/dt
dx = state_lift z + state_input_lift du
For an initial profile: z(0) = state_projection dx(0); du = 0; z(t) = exp(A t) z(0)
limitations: This is a local frozen linear model. Truncated stable, unstable or lightly damped modes can change response and stability conclusions; compare the full system across the intended frequency range and refine the mode set and mesh.
Conjugate pairs are retained together. Dependent or defective selected modes are rejected; generalized eigenvector/Jordan models are not yet supported.

Constant real inputs support flap/engine settings, selected controller commands, active frame targets, prescribed accelerations and fixed spatial gusts. Convected gust phase requires frequency-dependent input matrices and is not supported by this constant-matrix export.

The algebraic lift retains direct constraint and acceleration response. Inputs requiring derivatives in the descriptor state are rejected. D_rate explicitly represents any derivative-input sensor feedthrough.
Named global and Sensor measurements use file physical units; all angular measurement outputs use degrees. State-lift rows use the documented scaled descriptor coordinates.

Initial profiles are completed in the full finite descriptor space before mass-dual projection. Omitted state and output errors are reported; this is a frozen linear free response, not nonlinear time initialization. Laplace convergence is checked against the full spectrum, including omitted unstable modes.
OpenSwing ROM JSON and text are versioned original formats. Legacy ASWING .rom byte compatibility and published aircraft/experimental ROM validation remain unverified.
